scene_01.text: We made the same one-minute video with one render job, as in version zero point one, and with four, [[steps]] in the laptop's silent and turbo modes. [[render]] Only the two render steps change.

scene_02.text: In silent mode, [[silent]] four jobs render two point three times faster. In turbo mode, [[turbo]] everything is faster, but the gain is smaller: two point one times. [[same]] And the video is the same, frame for frame.
